name: klogg-electron
description: Windows desktop shell for the klogg Web UI
author: Anton Filimonov and klogg contributors

scripts.pack: npm run build:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win dir --x64
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux dir --x64
scripts.dist: npm run build:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.dist:zip: npm run build:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win zip --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:resources && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --x64
